text:
hana: Observing a lot of eviction noise from micro-prefixes. Quick thing: micro-bucket packing to reduce churn.
leo: How different from full namespace buckets?
hana: micro-buckets are ephemeral: group prefixes with low recent QPS and small size into a packed slab. Demote at bucket level with hysteresis to avoid oscillation.
nora: Key invariants: no cross-tenant exposure; keep prefix-lease for active cursors; packed state must be visible cluster-wide before serving demoted reads.
tariq: Implementation sketch: 1) identify candidates via decay score; 2) assign deterministic bucket id = ns || (hash(prefix)%N) || size_class; 3) write bucket manifest to a small strongly-consistent store with epoch; 4) flip demote flag once manifest committed.
leo: On reads: if miss and bloom says member, trigger fast rehydrate; if bloom negative, fallback normal cold fetch. Bloom false positives OK.
hana: Telemetry: pack_rate, bucket_revive_ratio, post-demote revive_count, cold_miss_p99. Auto-disable if revive_ratio > 0.2 for a tenant over 1h.
nora: Tests: lease-race sim (demote in-flight + cursor renew), cross-node manifest lag test, and perf: promote latency < 50ms median.
tariq: Rollout: staging 0.5% tenants for 72h, start with N=64 buckets/namespace, bloom FP=0.01, conservative grace window.
ops-bot: INF-4310 created: "micro-bucket packing prototype + canary" assigned to @hana, @leo, @nora.
